findings.title: Unsubscribing from a watching topic still leaves notifications enabled
findings.body: When the current notification level is `watching` or `tracking`, this branch changes it to `regular`, which is not muted and continues sending ordinary topic notifications. The page and email promise to stop notifications, but the user remains subscribed; the unsubscribe action should move the topic to a level that actually suppresses those notifications.

findings.title: The email unsubscribe link mutates state on GET
findings.body: This action is reached through a GET link in notification emails and changes the user's topic notification level. Email security scanners commonly follow links automatically, so merely scanning an email can unsubscribe its recipient without their intent. Use a confirmation step or a state-changing request that is only submitted after explicit user action.
